stem: Which approach to the syringe is advised when a clinician delivers local anesthesia to children and adolescents?

options.text: Use clinical expertise to camouflage the syringe.
Leave the syringe in full view so the patient can see it throughout.
Camouflage the syringe only for adolescents and not for children.
Avoid any camouflage of the syringe, because it is not recommended.
